title: PromptPairsResponse
description: Output schema for the generating-prompt-pairs skill (V0.2.1). Requires cross_lingual_robustness_strategy per pair; rejects user_prompts and any undeclared field.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt for Gemma-4-31B-it. Must be robust across all enabled TRYON_PROMPTS phrasings.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt for FLUX (optional). Use null or omit when no negative prompt is needed. Values 'None', 'none', 'NULL', empty string, or whitespace-only are normalized to null.

rationale.description: Non-empty explanation of why this pair was chosen and what specific issue it addresses.

expected_improvement_target.description: The metric or category (e.g. edit_correctness, cross_lingual_gap) this pair is expected to improve.

risk.description: Potential downside or regression risk for this pair.

cross_lingual_robustness_strategy.description: Non-empty description of how this system_prompt achieves robustness across zh and en phrasings. Must address: which phrasing is weakest (worst_user_prompt_id), how the prompt avoids single-keyword dependency, and how zh/en balance is maintained.

items.description: A single (system_prompt, negative_prompt) candidate pair. The user_prompts field is NOT accepted here — user prompts are a controlled evaluation variable, not a search target.
